name: Ex Diris

frame.name: Corrupted Nucleosynthesis
frame.description: This weapon enrages when dealing or taking sustained damage, gaining increased rate of fire while enraged.

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Nucleosynthetic Magazine
perks.description: This magazine continuously draws ammo from reserves. The magazine also enables firing Arc projectiles that detonate on impact.

perks.name: Loyal Moths
perks.description: Final blows and rapid direct hits with this weapon create a loyal moth. The moth will seek out nearby targets and detonate, damaging and blinding them.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

flavor: "I have heralded disaster so often that my mere presence is an omen. So be it." —Eris Morn

catalyst.name: Ex Diris Catalyst
catalyst.description: Weapon enrages faster while amplified. Final blows with this weapon make you amplified.
